g.text: RF capture hardware has already converted the carrier to baseband I/Q. This
profile processes a saved file. It does not directly sample the 433.92 MHz

g.text: TRF1 identifies raw I/Q input. The audio TSH2 image expects PCM. These are
separate application images using the same numerical core.
